task.title: P6-086: Stop query bar debounce from overwriting a facet click made within its 250ms window
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Catalog, search and paging). Original id: P6-086. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**A facet click inside the query bar's 250 ms debounce window is overwritten by the debounce firing with its captured text, losing the rail edit.** `rail.rs:952-956`'s own comment names this as the still-open, filed-separately race. Needs the pending-timer handle shared between the rail (which commits through its own `use_navigate_query`) and the query bar (whose `StoredValue` timeout handle is private to `QueryBar`). The context has to be local-storage rather than a plain one because `use_navigate`'s closure is not `Send` — note that is a constraint on the *navigate* closure, not on the `TimeoutHandle` itself.
